nodes.title: A declarative config can be tuned without fitting examples
nodes.description: Strategy is a hashed config. Tuning uses game win rate and the dev position set. Held-out positions and live results are only a check.
nodes.rationale: A rule for one species, move, or fixture does not transfer. Generated and mined positions, split by a hash, keep sweeps off the held-out set.
nodes.expected_effect: Any registered combination of agent, search, evaluator, opponent model, policies, context, advisor, models, and meta controller can be built with buildBot and compared on win rate plus dev-set agreement.
nodes.test_plan: Unit tests for registry, merge, hash, env isolation, identical selfplay and local decisions, the holdout split, and generalization. Validate every config. Smoke 20 paired games. Promotion stays on the gate.

nodes.title: Loss reviewer defaults to Grok 4.7
nodes.description: Do not default the post-game reviewer to anthropic/claude-opus-4.5. Prefer the newest xAI Grok frontier model on the gateway.
nodes.context: Queried GET https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models on 2026-10-04. Newest Grok language model is spacexai/grok-4.7 (released 2026-09-21). Newer language models exist (openai/gpt-6.1-sol 2026-09-29, anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 2026-09-22) and are recorded as alternatives. Claude Opus 4.5 is outdated and is not the default.
nodes.decision: Default LOSS_REVIEWER_MODEL is spacexai/grok-4.7. Input $0.000002/token ($2/1M), output $0.000006/token ($6/1M), cached input $0.0000005/token. Long context above 200001 tokens is input $0.000004 and output $0.000012. Override with the LOSS_REVIEWER_MODEL env var.
alternatives: anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 at input $0.000004/token ($4/1M) and output $0.00002/token ($20/1M), released 2026-09-22
openai/gpt-6.1-sol at input $0.000002/token ($2/1M) and output $0.00001/token ($10/1M), released 2026-09-29
nodes.consequences: Reviewer findings are hypotheses only and are not applied to code. Jev stays the in-search advisor at typesafe-ai/jev, input $0.000000042/token ($0.042/1M) and output $0.

nodes.kill_condition: Reject on any guardrail violation or if SPRT accepts H0 (no Elo gain).

nodes.title: Jev prior on top-K search actions
nodes.description: Off by default. A gate challenger may blend Jev scores into search. Missing key or timeout degrades to pure search. Not applied to the champion.

metadata.killCondition: Reject if any hard guardrail fails, including timeouts or p99 >= 2s, or if SPRT accepts no difference.

nodes.rationale: Random-battle search scores are often close. A fast evaluation model can score the same top-K actions and either nudge the ranking (prior) or break ties, without replacing search.
nodes.expected_effect: Challenger Elo vs the frozen panel rises by about +10 if the prior corrects systematic mistakes, with p99 turn time still under 2s.
nodes.test_plan: Submit experiment-llm-jev-prior against the champion through the gate. Challenger config is experiments/llm-jev-prior/config.json (blend mode prior, weight 0.15, topK 8). Champion stays useLLMPrior false. Paired games, SPRT elo0=0 elo1=+10 alpha=beta=0.05.
